items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: So Duck Winnie's had another cornet player in the band, it was Kid Rene. So he was using two cornets, Kid Rene and myself.

ctx.x: You heard of that band? Yeah, they still have one.

It was run by a bass player called Duck Winnie's. So Duck Winnie's had another cornet player in the band, it was Kid Rene. So he was using two cornets, Kid Rene and myself. He was never awful, but powerful cornet player, played very high at that time. So Duck said, Lee, I'm going to leave Rene go because Rene is getting to drinking too much and I think he's going to spoil you and start you drinking. I never was a guy who could drink much whiskey. Anyway, at the time a few drinks I drank, it always made me sick.…
Upstairs. Upstairs. There's a Pythian temple they call it sometime I think.
